title: recforge and the survey "Self-Evolving Recommender Systems: A Survey and an Evaluation Audit" (code, audit data, paper)
description: recforge: one protocol to benchmark and evolve recommenders (leave-one-out, full-catalogue ranking, sealed test, budgeted evolve sessions). Includes the survey paper 'Self-Evolving Recommender Systems: A Survey and an Evaluation Audit' (papers/self-evolving-recsys-survey/draft/paper.pdf), its coded audit of 27 self-evolving recommender systems (audit/audit.csv) and the verbatim evidence behind every coded cell.
